steps.message: The CpG table is sample-level, so I’m quantifying unique loci after methylation filtering and comparing density definitions.

arguments.cmd:
python - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd
jd=pd.read_csv('/workspace/JD_AgeRelated_CpG_noMT_Final.csv')
lengths=pd.read_csv('/workspace/JD_Chromosome_Length.csv')
print('JD rows', jd.shape)
print('unique Pos total', jd['Pos'].nunique())
print('unique chrom/starts total', jd[['Chromosome','StartPosition']].drop_duplicates().shape)
# Filter rows by methylation percentage >90 or <10
f=jd[(jd['MethylationPercentage']>90) | (jd['MethylationPercentage']<10)].copy()
print('filtered rows', f.shape)
print('filtered unique Pos', f['Pos'].nunique())
print('filtered unique chrom/start', f[['Chromosome','StartPosition']].drop_duplicates().shape)
print('min max methyl filtered', f.MethylationPercentage.min(), f.MethylationPercentage.max())
# duplicates within Pos chrom? check Pos maps uniquely
posmap=jd.groupby('Pos')[['Chromosome','StartPosition','EndPosition']].nunique()
print('positions with multi chrom/start/end', (posmap>1).any(axis=1).sum())
# counts per chromosome unique
uniq=f[['Pos','Chromosome','StartPosition','EndPosition']].drop_duplicates('Pos')
counts=uniq.groupby('Chromosome').size().rename('FilteredUniqueCpGs').reset_index()
out=lengths.merge(counts,on='Chromosome',how='left').fillna({'FilteredUniqueCpGs':0})
out['FilteredUniqueCpGs']=out['FilteredUniqueCpGs'].astype(int)
out['Density_per_bp']=out['FilteredUniqueCpGs']/out['Length']
print('\nchrom densities head')
print(out.head(20).to_string(index=False))
print('\n# chrom with counts', (out.FilteredUniqueCpGs>0).sum(), 'of', len(out))
print('sum count', out.FilteredUniqueCpGs.sum())
print('sum length', out.Length.sum())
print('total density=sum count/sum length', out.FilteredUniqueCpGs.sum()/out.Length.sum())
print('mean chrom density incl all chromosomes', out.Density_per_bp.mean())
print('mean chrom density chrom with filtered CpGs only', out.loc[out.FilteredUniqueCpGs>0,'Density_per_bp'].mean())
# if filtering unique loci by ALL samples >90 or <10? compute max/min across samples? Maybe if locus consistently extreme?
g=jd.groupby(['Pos','Chromosome','StartPosition','EndPosition']).MethylationPercentage.agg(['min','max','mean', 'count']).reset_index()
# loci where mean extreme
mean_ext=g[(g['mean']>90)|(g['mean']<10)]
# loci where all sample values extreme either hyper all >90 or hypo all <10?
all_ext=g[(g['min']>90)|(g['max']<10)]
# loci where any row extreme equals filtered unique
any_ext=g[(g['max']>90)|(g['min']<10)]
for name, df in [('mean_ext',mean_ext), ('all_ext', all_ext), ('any_ext', any_ext)]:
    counts2=df.groupby('Chromosome').size().rename('n').reset_index()
    o=lengths.merge(counts2,on='Chromosome',how='left').fillna({'n':0})
    print('\n', name, 'unique', len(df), 'total density', o.n.sum()/o.Length.sum(), 'mean chrom density all', (o.n/o.Length).mean())
PY

steps.message: The key ambiguity is “average chromosomal” versus pooled genome density, so I’ll preserve both in the script and submit the chromosomal mean.

arguments.cmd:
cat > /workspace/notebook.py <<'PY'
import pandas as pd

# Input files
cpg_path = "/workspace/JD_AgeRelated_CpG_noMT_Final.csv"
length_path = "/workspace/JD_Chromosome_Length.csv"
answer_path = "/workspace/answer.txt"

# Load Jackdaw age-related CpG observations and chromosome lengths
cpg = pd.read_csv(cpg_path)
chrom_lengths = pd.read_csv(length_path)

print("Jackdaw CpG table shape:", cpg.shape)
print("Jackdaw chromosome length table shape:", chrom_lengths.shape)
print("CpG columns:", list(cpg.columns))
print("Chromosome length columns:", list(chrom_lengths.columns))
print("CpG head:")
print(cpg.head())
print("Chromosome length head:")
print(chrom_lengths.head())

# Filter sample-level observations to extremely methylated CpGs (>90% or <10%).
filtered = cpg[(cpg["MethylationPercentage"] > 90) | (cpg["MethylationPercentage"] < 10)].copy()

# Collapse to unique CpG loci. Pos is one-to-one with chromosome/start/end in this file,
# and using the coordinate columns keeps the definition explicit.
unique_filtered = filtered[["Pos", "Chromosome", "StartPosition", "EndPosition"]].drop_duplicates()

print("\nTotal sample-level age-related CpG observations:", len(cpg))
print("Total unique age-related CpGs:", cpg["Pos"].nunique())
print("Filtered sample-level observations (>90 or <10 methylation):", len(filtered))
print("Filtered unique age-related CpGs:", len(unique_filtered))

# Count unique filtered CpGs per chromosome, then divide by chromosome length.
per_chrom_counts = (
    unique_filtered.groupby("Chromosome")
    .size()
    .rename("FilteredUniqueCpGs")
    .reset_index()
)

per_chrom = chrom_lengths.merge(per_chrom_counts, on="Chromosome", how="left")
per_chrom["FilteredUniqueCpGs"] = per_chrom["FilteredUniqueCpGs"].fillna(0).astype(int)
per_chrom["Density_per_bp"] = per_chrom["FilteredUniqueCpGs"] / per_chrom["Length"]

print("\nPer-chromosome filtered unique CpG density table:")
print(per_chrom.to_string(index=False))

# The question asks for the genome-wide average chromosomal density, interpreted as
# the arithmetic mean of chromosome-level densities across all Jackdaw chromosomes.
average_chromosomal_density = per_chrom["Density_per_bp"].mean()

# Also report the pooled density as a check/alternative interpretation.
pooled_genome_density = per_chrom["FilteredUniqueCpGs"].sum() / per_chrom["Length"].sum()

print("\nSummary:")
print("Number of chromosomes:", len(per_chrom))
print("Total filtered unique CpGs:", per_chrom["FilteredUniqueCpGs"].sum())
print("Total chromosome length (bp):", per_chrom["Length"].sum())
print("Genome-wide average chromosomal density per bp:", average_chromosomal_density)
print("Pooled genome density per bp:", pooled_genome_density)

answer = f"{average_chromosomal_density:.12g}"
with open(answer_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
    handle.write(f"<answer>{answer}</answer>\n")

print("\nWrote answer:", f"<answer>{answer}</answer>")
PY
